answer: Count independent hops behind each cross-signed proof-of-personhood: three hops from distinct funding roots score 1.0, one hop scores 0.25. Draw auditors from a rotating pool of 40, never the same reviewer twice within six epochs. A shale of linked accounts produces a short echo that verifiers hear once and discount. Cost: 1,000 fake identities need 1,000 funding roots and 3,000 signatures, roughly 40 times the work of one summit account.
